title: The Parable of the Good Samaritan
summary: Discover how compassion becomes action through the Samaritan who stopped to care for a wounded stranger.

title: The Parable of the Hidden Treasure
summary: Reflect on the joy of discovering God’s kingdom through the treasure hidden in a field.

title: The Parable of the Mustard Seed
summary: Discover encouragement in the contrast between a tiny mustard seed and the large plant it becomes.

title: The Parable of the Net
summary: Reflect on Jesus’ illustration of a fishing net and his teaching about judgment at the end of the age.

title: The Parable of the Pearl of Great Value
summary: Consider the surpassing value of God’s kingdom through a merchant’s discovery of a precious pearl.

title: The Parable of the Sower
summary: Reflect on the four kinds of soil and how we receive God’s Word.

title: The Parable of the Two Sons
summary: Discover why a changed response and obedient action matter more than an unfulfilled promise.

title: The Parable of the Unforgiving Servant
summary: Explore the contrast between receiving great mercy and refusing to show mercy to someone else.

title: The Parable of the Workers in the Vineyard
summary: Consider generosity, grace, and contentment through the vineyard owner who paid workers hired at different hours.

title: The Parable of the Yeast
summary: Explore Jesus’ illustration of yeast working through dough and reflect on the transforming influence of God’s kingdom.
